title: Cortado: Espresso Cut with Warm Milk
summary: A double espresso cut with roughly the same amount of gently steamed milk in a small glass, topped with just a thin line of foam.

ingredients.note: steam at least this much; about 45 ml goes in the glass

steps.title: Pull the shot
steps.text: Pull a double espresso, 18 g in and about 40 ml out, directly into the glass tumbler.

steps.title: Steam gently
steps.text: Let in air for only 1-2 s, then heat the milk with the tip deep in the jug to 55-60 °C. Slightly cooler milk tastes sweeter, so the small drink can be sipped straight away.

steps.title: Settle
steps.text: Tap the jug and swirl until the milk is smooth, with only a thin layer of foam.

steps.title: Cut
steps.text: Pour about 45 ml of the milk into the espresso, close to equal parts, letting a thin pale line of foam settle on top.

tips: Steam more milk than you need; tiny amounts are hard to texture.
Use the leftover milk for a second drink or for porridge.
Serve in a glass so you can see the layers of coffee and milk.
storage: Serve immediately. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
